node.label: Antoinette Burton
node.date_label: Burdens of History (1994) · After the Imperial Turn (edited collection) (2003) · Gender History: A Very Short Introduction (2024)
node.description: A historian of Britain and empire whose gender-history intervention treats sexual difference as something produced and managed in historical circumstances. Her account connects gender to slavery, capitalism and empire while distinguishing gender history from simply adding women to existing narratives.
